q0AnchorReason: Evaluates at the PROTON pin. q0 enters through q_parameter.Q_50_DIGIT_STR, which resolves to the proton anchor (1.1099785827513808075...) because this stem is not listed under ideal_muon; proton is the standing default for compute per the 2026-08-07 owner directive. A manifest entry would be inert here -- the manifest is read inside WitnessBuilder.build(), and this producer hand-rolls its witness and never enters build() -- so the declaration is made producer-side, the only route that reaches the file.
name: alpha-scale-is-outside-the-trace
description: The trace channel supplies 20.6-33.8 % of one alpha-cluster unit (29.8 MeV) even at the complete graph, so the alpha-cluster scale must come from outside it; plus the two-row support of the Schur-Weyl sum, extended to n=3,12,15.
scope: (a) — pure-proton chains for the trace figures; 29.8 MeV/alpha is the corpus's measured mean, cited not re-derived; no mechanism proposed for the missing scale

assertions.name: q_0 is the PROTON pin (the pin the L values were measured at)
assertions.detail: Q_50_DIGIT_STR = 1.109978582751380807..., muon pin = 1.109978595557334719...; they differ at the 9th digit and the proton prefix 1.10997858 is present.

assertions.name: the trace channel supplies under 35 % of one alpha, even at the complete graph
assertions.detail: 33.83 % at the complete graph with every interference term included — which the preceding work showed is the most the bond topology can produce (additive capped at 20.649 MeV with per-bond values FREE; non-additive at 10.083 MeV with the A=4 many-body sign measured NEGATIVE). The missing bulk is not in this channel.

assertions.name: only two-row partitions carry weight, at every strand count tested
assertions.detail: NOT NEW: the t7qv witness already records that every partition with >= 3 rows carries weight exactly zero, verified there at n=6 and n=9. Added here: n=3, 12, 15 and the total-vs-nonzero counts. Incremental, and reported as such.

assertions.name: the tempting representation-theoretic inference is named and declined
assertions.detail: Stating it would be a stronger result and an invalid one. The numerical exclusion stands on its own and is what is claimed.

assertions.name: the extensive target is the BULK coefficient, and the trace supplies under 20 % of it
assertions.detail: 15.99 % of the bulk requirement, against 33.83 % of the observed 4He binding. Both are reported because they answer different questions; the bulk one is what an EXTENSIVE term must meet, and it is the stricter.

assertions.name: the open target is stated as a magnitude, with no mechanism proposed
assertions.detail: missing fraction per alpha: 66.17 % to 79.36 %. The corpus has the STRUCTURE derived (proved SU(4) gate) and the SCALE open; this bounds the scale from below by what the trace cannot supply.
